description: Match a config filename against the SchemaStore catalog (schemastore.org) to find which JSON Schemas declare a fileMatch glob covering it, for example package.json, tsconfig.json, or .github/workflows/ci.yml. Returns the matching catalog entries with schema name, description, fileMatch globs, and the json.schemastore.org schema URL. Answers which JSON Schema validates a given config file so an editor or linter can be pointed at it.
name: find_schema_for
